text:
Anya (Design): Heads-up — I pushed a microcopy change for the session-restore tooltip in the Console. Current copy feels vague when auth expires during a long edit. PTAL: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz
Sam (PM): saw it. what are the options?
Anya (Design): two short variants: 
1) 'Session expired. Restore previous session to continue.'
2) 'You were signed out. Restore your unsaved work?'
Sam (PM): i prefer #1 but maybe shorten — folks skim tooltips.
Jo (Accessibility): quick a11y check: tooltip needs role="status" and keyboard focusable link. also avoid question mark for CTAs.
Mike (Frontend): implementation note: tooltip component only supports a single CTA text right now. can we settle on a 4–6 word CTA? e.g., 'Restore session' or 'Restore work'
Anya (Design): ok new proposals: 
- primary label: 'Session expired'
- body: 'Restore your unsaved work to continue.'
- CTA: 'Restore session'
Could also show a secondary 'Sign in' link for reauth.
Sam (PM): how about: body → 'We signed you out so your account stays secure. Restore your unsaved work?'
Jo (Accessibility): tone's fine but 'signed you out' sounds passive. prefer 'You signed out' only if user action. Use neutral: 'You were signed out' is clearer. Also ensure tooltip text reads at 14px and 4.5:1 contrast for text against bg.
Anya (Design): good catch. Updated copy: 
`Session expired — you were signed out for security. Restore your unsaved work.`
Mike (Frontend): that fits. small nit: remove em-dash for compact tooltip. inline code for implementation: `Tooltip({title: 'Session expired', body: 'You were signed out for security. Restore your unsaved work.', cta: 'Restore session'})`
Jo (Accessibility): please add link text that clearly indicates destination: 'Restore session (opens editor)' is verbose but explicit — maybe do a visually hidden text for screen readers: 'Restore session — returns you to the editor with unsaved changes'.
Sam (PM): getting detailed. For launch let's use: body = 'You were signed out for security. Restore your unsaved work.' CTA = 'Restore session' and include an aria-label on CTA: 'Restore session and return to editor'.
Anya (Design): cool — i'll update the figma and the copy doc. Mike can you wire the aria-label and ensure focus lands on CTA for keyboard users?
Mike (Frontend): yup. i'll add role=dialog/aria-modal where appropriate and add the aria-label. will also add a tiny e2e to assert focus goes to CTA.
figma-bot: Updated file: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz (version 4) :white_check_mark:
Anya (Design): thanks all. quick follow-up: should we show a small help link in tooltip 'Why did I get signed out?' pointing to docs? reaction? :thumbsup: :eyes:
Sam (PM): yes pls — low priority, create ticket for docs link and analytics when tooltip shows.
Anya (Design): created ticket -> #1234. I'll iterate copy in the figma and ping for a final pass. :raised_hands:
